description: This file defines the SanitizerException class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically within the Core Exception namespace. It extends the base PHP Exception class and provides a static method to generate a specific exception message related to badly formatted SVG files.

classes.name: SanitizerException
classes.description: A custom exception class for handling sanitizer-related errors, extending the base PHP Exception class.

methods.name: svgBadlyFormatted
methods.description: Returns a new instance of SanitizerException with a specific message indicating that an SVG is badly formatted.
